Questions Houston homeowners ask

The PDF did not open. What now?

Use the button on this page, open the checklist (PDF). Most phones and computers open it in the browser, and you can save or print it from there.

I asked for a roofer to call. What happens next?

If you added your phone number, your details go to a local roofing company so it can call you about an inspection. When it calls depends on the company and the weather. You can also call the line yourself at any hour.

Where can I read more about storm claims?

The roof insurance claims guide covers deductibles, actual cash value, deadlines and what a roofer may and may not do under Texas law.
